design_description: A striking geometric design built on the Mosaic template, featuring an all-over checkerboard composition in deep royal blue and metallic silver-grey. The irregular block sizing and staggered alignment create a sense of digital movement and visual distortion, giving the classic checker pattern a more modern, technical feel. Gold trims on the collar and sleeve cuffs add warmth and elevate the palette with a premium contrast. Overall, the jersey feels futuristic and rhythmic — blending retro arcade-inspired graphics with contemporary football aesthetics.
